title: Chris Gayle Post Match Interview | West Indies vs Australia, 3rd T20
quote_text:
Master blaster Chris Gayle smashes Australia in St Lucia:

The world’s highest run scorer in T20 cricket has smashed the West Indies to victory in the third CG Insurance T20 International in St Lucia.

International T20 cricket journeyman Chris Gayle played yet another smash and grab innings for the current World Champions, burying Australia in an avalanche of sixes.

Australia posted a total of 141 when Moises Henriques and Ashton Turner overcame a steady flow of wickets, before Gayle smashed them out of the park.

Australia’s bowlers had the West Indies on par before Gayle belted five sixes and a boundary in just two overs to take the game. He made 67 from 38 balls with four boundaries and seven sixes.

A solid start by openers Matthew Wade and Aaron Finch was followed by more steady wickets which has been a sign on the tour so far. Wade made 23 from 16 before being bowled stepping away from his wicket while Finch was a run a ball before falling to a freakish outfield catch.

Henriques and Turner steadied the ship after Mitch Marsh, the best of the opening two games, fell for nine and Alex Carey for 13. The Sixers captain made 33 form 29 and Turner 24 from 22 but Australia was unable to hit enough boundaries.

West Indies leggie Hayden Walsh bogged the Australians down for the second night running taking 2-18 from his four overs while veteran Dwayne Bravo took 1-17 from three.

#ChrisGayle #WIvAUS
